dedupe_keys.name: grdl global reservoir area storage depth dataset through reconstructed bathymetry using deep learning

description: Researchers at the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Wuhan University publish GRDL, reconstructed area-storage-depth profiles for reservoirs indexed by GRanD identifiers. The original record explicitly redirects users to a newer Zenodo version. That record supplies CSV profiles of area in square kilometres, storage in million cubic metres and depth in metres, together with a separate reservoir-area coverage ratio. Maximum area comes from JRC Global Surface Water, while depth begins at the lowest reconstructed bathymetric elevation. A ZIP archive and the quality-related CSV are openly available and free under CC-BY-4.0. These are static, model-derived relationships, not a time series of surveyed reservoir volumes. A limitation stated by the provider is that image resampling may reduce accuracy for reservoirs larger than 100 square kilometres. The profiles could convert observed area or water level to storage in reservoir simulations. They complement data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database with bathymetric relationships, subject to identifier matching and interpretation of the coverage-quality field.
